title: Do Cool Sh*t
medium: Mixed media on MDF, epoxy resin
meta: Medium: Mixed media on MDF panel, layered with high-gloss epoxy resin
Framing: Handcrafted wooden frame, delivered ready to hang
statement:
DO COOL SH*T is a bold reminder to break free — from expectations, overthinking, and the pressure to always have a plan. As an artist, my goal with this piece is to capture the raw energy of letting go and doing what feels good, without obsessing over outcomes.

Sometimes, that's exactly what life calls for: less analysis, more action. More joy. More play. This piece celebrates spontaneity, rebellion, and the freedom to simply live — and live colorfully.
